r2_protection: These are new local characters. They do not replace, repeat, impersonate, or decide for R2 characters.

profiles.name: Nessa Ril
profiles.title: Guia de travessia
profiles.tension: Wants to shelter displaced people but fears opening an unsafe passage.
profiles.knowledge_boundary: Knows local traffic and observed signs; cannot confirm R2 facts or sealed events.
profiles.story_hook: Her safe detour can become a lifeline or an excuse to abandon the blocked route.

profiles.name: Dorian Kesh
profiles.title: Investigador de campo
profiles.function: Collects and compares physical evidence near the nest.
profiles.tension: Suspects deliberate provocation but lacks proof strong enough to accuse anyone.
profiles.knowledge_boundary: May present evidence and uncertainty; cannot resolve a sealed case.
profiles.story_hook: A correct precaution may look like cowardice while a wrong accusation can divide Varga.

profiles.name: Vara Teln
profiles.title: Respondente de risco
profiles.function: Briefs travelers and authorizes local containment procedure.
profiles.tension: Prioritizes closing the route until it is safe, even when the delay harms the displaced.
profiles.knowledge_boundary: Can coordinate evacuation and nonlethal containment; cannot make authorial death decisions.
profiles.story_hook: Her procedure protects bodies but makes every delay politically visible.
